tests/game.test.js.name: Coach tests
tests/game.test.js.description: Plays the Hard coach against every possible game, checks every hint's reason is true and in the right order, and tests the levels and the loss line.

tests/load.js.name: Test loader
tests/load.js.description: Reads the coach's brains and the words straight from src and runs them so the quick checks can call them without a browser.

tests/run.js.name: Run all quick checks
tests/run.js.description: Runs the words checks and the coach checks one after the other; this is what npm test calls.

tests/strings.test.js.name: Words tests
tests/strings.test.js.description: Checks every sentence exists in all three languages with the same placeholders, well-formed plurals, and no shouting or em dashes.
